sections.title: Physics for Architects I
sections.description: An introduction to the classical laws of mechanics, including static equilibrium, elasticity, and oscillations, with emphasis on topics most relevant to students in architecture. Credit is awarded for only one of the following courses: PHYS 0008, PHYS 0101, PHYS 0150, or PHYS 0170. Students with AP or Transfer Credit for PHYS 091 or 093 who complete PHYS 0008 will thereby surrender the AP or Transfer Credit.
